call_input.prompt:
Use case: text-localization
Asset type: one finished Korean square online recruitment poster.
Input image: the attached H02 repair-1 poster is the only edit target. Edit this source poster, do not make multiple images or variants. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Primary edit: Restore invitation priority in this monochrome two-column poster. The event title, recruitment line and complete application sentence must be the clear first reading. The source currently gives non-guarantee, bring-item and photo-consent sentences headline size; reduce all right-column conditions to consistent, comfortable subordinate body typography, with only modest weight differences. Keep every policy fully present and unsoftened. Do not remove any words to create hierarchy.

Concrete typographic reflow:
- Keep the black-on-white two-column editorial structure, clean margins and actual bag/magnifier photograph.
- Let the left invitation column use slightly more width than the source. Set “고쳐 쓰는 토요일” as its clear bold event heading, readable in one line if it fits naturally, otherwise wrap at an existing word space. It remains confined to the invitation column rather than becoming a full-width masthead.
- Put the recruitment subtitle directly below at an intermediate size. Place the FULL application sentence next, in readable ordinary text, with the deadline moderately bold and the entire continuous URL directly beneath if needed. This title/recruitment/application group must visually lead the conditions.
- Clarify the left date/time/place and eligibility. Give these and inquiry comfortable text, approximately 20–22px equivalent in a 720px-wide viewing copy. Wrap at word boundaries when needed, especially the long time sentence; never force it into tiny single-line type. The URL should be approximately 22–24px equivalent and never be split within the address.
- The title may be about twice the body scale; the subtitle about 1.2 times the body. These are relative typography targets, not generation-resolution parameters.
- Begin the right condition groups level with the lower portion of the invitation/application area so that there is no competing condition headline at the top. Use roughly 20–22px equivalent body type at 720px width, consistent line spacing around 1.3 times body height, and at most regular/medium weight. No policy sentence may have the title's scale or heavy headline weight.
- Keep the meaningful right-side relationships: full inspection/non-guarantee sentence with tools/component-cost notice; bring-one-item with exclusions; photo consent with fee/payment. Use actual sentence content and deliberate whitespace to group them. No invented group headers, numbered steps, icons, cards, rules, checklist marks, quotation marks or decorative microtype.
- Reallocate the source's very large inter-block gaps to readable line lengths and adequate left practical text. Do not create a giant blank right top area. There should be enough space for natural word-boundary wraps of all full conditions at the stated comfortable body scale.
- Keep application near the early reading point. No colored CTA panel, no bottom application/footer band, no huge full-width headline, no copy piled over the photo.

Photo invariants: Preserve the source's actual photograph of ONE frayed household canvas bag with a black-handled magnifier resting over the loose handle-attachment seam. It continues to show inspection of unresolved damage, not a completed repair. Preserve credible glass/frame/fabric contact, canvas weave, loose existing seam fibers, natural muted material colors and the original consistent soft light/contact shadows. The photo may be scaled and repositioned within the lower left to fit the refined typography, but do not add objects, hands, people, needles, spools or a new backdrop. Do not redraw it as an illustration or alter the inspection relationship.

Exact copy invariants: All fourteen supplied items below must occur exactly once, with original spelling, word spaces, punctuation, dates, names, numbers, cost and full URL intact. Allowed wrapping is at natural word boundaries only. The compound “전기·배터리” stays tight with the original middle dot and no added word spaces. Preserve the en dash in the time range, middle dots elsewhere and comma in 5,000원. Render only these words, not the instructions or labels:
고쳐 쓰는 토요일
이웃 수리 작업실 참여자 모집
2026년 12월 5일 토요일
오후 2시–5시 · 입장은 오후 1시 40분부터
하람시 잇는집 2층 · 수선길 12
대상: 만 16세 이상 · 회차별 12명
작은 생활용품 한 점을 가져와 주세요.
전기·배터리 제품과 위험한 물건은 받지 않습니다.
도구는 제공하며 부품 비용은 현장에서 안내합니다.
수리 여부는 상태 확인 후 결정하며 완성을 보장하지 않습니다.
촬영은 동의한 참여자에 한해 진행합니다.
참가비 5,000원 · 현장 결제
12월 2일까지 신청: haram-mend.example/join
문의: 이웃 수리 운영팀

Output invariants: One independent flat square 1:1 poster. Preserve monochrome editorial type and the same inspection photo's function/material/contact. No mockup, collage, panel set, logos, badges, watermarks, extra copy, invented event facts or promises. No electric/battery or hazardous brought item. No repair guarantee. All full longest conditions must remain comfortably readable at 720px width.

residuals: Photo crop and fiber/lens details were re-rendered; material/contact/inspection relationship retained but not pixel-identical.
Small clauses are not comfortable sustained reading at 320px; all readable at inspected 720px.
Time-range separator Unicode identity cannot be proven from raster pixels.
Two-column composition allows multiple scan paths.
